name: fp-motion
js: const sec = document.querySelector('#story'); const st = () => [sec.className, sec.querySelector('.fp-changed').textContent, sec.querySelector('.fp-board').className, sec.querySelector('.fp-board-n').textContent, sec.querySelector('.fp-board-st').textContent, [...sec.querySelectorAll('.fp-digit')].map(d => d.textContent).join(''), sec.querySelector('.sr-only').textContent.slice(0, 12), sec.querySelector('#fp-amount').value, sec.querySelector('.fp-print-box').innerHTML.length > 100].join(' | '); const out = [st()]; sec.querySelectorAll('.fp-step')[1].click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 5000)); out.push(st()); sec.querySelectorAll('.fp-step')[0].click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 5000)); out.push(st()); const d = sec.querySelector('#fp-due'); d.value = '2026-12-31'; d.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 5000)); out.push(st()); sec.querySelector('.fp-reset').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 5000)); out.push(st()); const a = sec.querySelector('#fp-amount'); a.value = '12'; a.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 5000)); out.push(st()); return out;
